sentences.en: Philosophers, dramatists, theologians have grappled with this question for centuries: what makes people go wrong?
sentences.zh: 我在纽约南布朗克斯市中的贫民窟长大，周围充满了罪恶，如同所有在贫民窟长大的孩子一样。我有一些朋友，他们曾是好孩子，但他们的人生却如同罗伯特·路易斯·斯蒂文森笔下的变身怪医，由善转恶。

sentences.en: Interestingly, I asked this question when I was a little kid.
sentences.zh: 但他们的人生却如同罗伯特·路易斯·斯蒂文森笔下的变身怪医，由善转恶。

sentences.en: I grew up in the South Bronx, inner-city ghetto in New York, and I was surrounded by evil, as all kids are who grew up in an inner city.
sentences.zh: 但他们的人生却如同罗伯特·路易斯·斯蒂文森笔下的变身怪医，由善转恶。他们染毒，惹了麻烦，然后进了监狱。有些丧了命，即使并没有沾染毒品。

sentences.en: And I had friends who were really good kids, who lived out the Dr. Jekyll Mr. Hyde scenario -- Robert Louis Stevenson.
sentences.zh: 有些丧了命，即使并没有沾染毒品。所以当我读罗伯特·路易斯·斯蒂文森的作品时，我觉得那不是小说。唯一的问题是：酿成由善转恶的毒药是什么？更重要的是，善恶之间的界限——

sentences.en: That is, they took drugs, got in trouble, went to jail.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，善恶之间的界限——

sentences.en: Some got killed, and some did it without drug assistance.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，善恶之间的界限——特权阶层喜欢认定这个界限是固定且不可逾越的，认为他们是在善的一边，其他人在恶的一边——

sentences.en: So when I read Robert Louis Stevenson, that wasn't fiction.
sentences.zh: 认为他们是在善的一边，其他人在恶的一边——而我以前就知道这个界限是可以移动的，而且是可逾越的。

sentences.en: The only question is, what was in the juice?
sentences.zh: 而我以前就知道这个界限是可以移动的，而且是可逾越的。

sentences.en: And more importantly, that line between good and evil -- which privileged people like to think is fixed and impermeable, with them on the good side, the others on the bad side -- I knew that line was movable, and it was permeable.
sentences.zh: 而我以前就知道这个界限是可以移动的，而且是可逾越的。好人可以受诱惑而越界，偶尔在某些比较好的情况下，坏孩子也可能依靠外界的帮助、改造、治疗，以重塑人生。所以，我想以荷兰艺术家M. C. Escher这幅奇妙的作品开始说起。

sentences.en: Good people could be seduced across that line, and under good and some rare circumstances, bad kids could recover with help, with reform, with rehabilitation.
sentences.zh: 这幅奇妙的作品开始说起。如果你把视线集中在白色区域，你会看到一个充满了天使的世界。但是当我们再靠近一点看，魔鬼就出现了，世间的魔鬼。

sentences.en: So I want to begin with this wonderful illusion by [Dutch] artist M.C. Escher.
sentences.zh: 魔鬼就出现了，世间的魔鬼。这告诉我们几点。一：这个世界，无论过去，现在，还是将来，都总是由善和恶组成，

sentences.en: If you look at it and focus on the white, what you see is a world full of angels.
sentences.zh: 一：这个世界，无论过去，现在，还是将来，都总是由善和恶组成，因为善恶就如人类的阴阳。

sentences.en: But let's look more deeply, and as we do, what appears is the demons, the devils in the world.
sentences.zh: 因为善恶就如人类的阴阳。它也告诉我另外一件事。如果你还记得，上帝最喜欢的天使是路西法。

sentences.en: That tells us several things. One, the world is, was, will always be filled with good and evil, because good and evil is the yin and yang of the human condition.
sentences.zh: 上帝最喜欢的天使是路西法。显然，路西法的意思是“光明”。在某些经文里，它也有“黎明之星”的意思。显然他后来背叛了上帝，

sentences.en: It tells me something else. If you remember, God's favorite angel was Lucifer.
sentences.zh: 显然他后来背叛了上帝，这是对权威的终极背叛。当他率众背叛后，上帝派迈克天使长

sentences.en: Apparently, Lucifer means "the light." It also means "the morning star," in some scripture.
sentences.zh: 当他率众背叛后，上帝派迈克天使长将他和其他堕落的天使一起赶出天堂。

sentences.en: And apparently, he disobeyed God, and that's the ultimate disobedience to authority.
sentences.zh: 将他和其他堕落的天使一起赶出天堂。于是路西法降入地狱，成为撒旦，成为恶魔，宇宙中的恶之能量诞生了。

sentences.en: And when he did, Michael, the archangel, was sent to kick him out of heaven along with the other fallen angels.
sentences.zh: 成为恶魔，宇宙中的恶之能量诞生了。矛盾的是，是上帝造出了恶的容身之处---地狱。他却没能使恶一直呆在那里。

sentences.en: And so Lucifer descends into hell, becomes Satan, becomes the devil, and the force of evil in the universe begins.
sentences.zh: 他却没能使恶一直呆在那里。所以，从上帝最受宠的天使变为恶魔，这个巨大的转变，为我设立了一个大背景，

sentences.en: Paradoxically, it was God who created hell as a place to store evil.
sentences.zh: 为我设立了一个大背景，去理解那些从好人或者普通人

sentences.en: He didn't do a good job of keeping it there though.
sentences.zh: 去理解那些从好人或者普通人转变成坏人的人。

sentences.en: So, this arc of the cosmic transformation of God's favorite angel into the Devil, for me, sets the context for understanding human beings who are transformed from good, ordinary people into perpetrators of evil.
sentences.zh: 转变成坏人的人。所以，路西法效应，尽管它集中在阴暗的方面——人们可能投向阴暗，但他们本身并非阴暗——引导我作出一个心理学定义：恶是行使权力

sentences.en: So the Lucifer effect, although it focuses on the negatives -- the negatives that people can become, not the negatives that people are -- leads me to a psychological definition.
sentences.zh: 引导我作出一个心理学定义：恶是行使权力这才是关键：权力。来故意对他人进行心理伤害，对他人进行身体伤害，残害他人生命或思想，犯下反人道的罪行。

sentences.en: Evil is the exercise of power. And that's the key: it's about power.
sentences.zh: 犯下反人道的罪行。如果你用谷歌搜索evil (恶) 这个词——时至今日，这本是个早应消亡的词，

sentences.en: To intentionally harm people psychologically, to hurt people physically, to destroy people mortally, or ideas, and to commit crimes against humanity.
sentences.zh: 如果你用谷歌搜索evil (恶) 这个词——时至今日，这本是个早应消亡的词，你会在1/3秒内得到1.36亿个搜索结果。几年前发生的一件事——我知道你们当时一定和我一样震惊，

sentences.en: If you Google "evil," a word that should surely have withered by now, you come up with 136 million hits in a third of a second.
sentences.zh: 就是揭露美军士兵在那场争议性的对伊战争中中的虐囚行为：阿布格莱布虐囚事件。

sentences.en: A few years ago -- I am sure all of you were shocked, as I was, with the revelation of American soldiers abusing prisoners in a strange place in a controversial war, Abu Ghraib in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 中的虐囚行为：阿布格莱布虐囚事件。这些士兵，有男性也有女性，对囚犯们实施了让人难以置信的羞辱。我很震惊，但是并不感到意外，因为我以前看到过类似的情况，当时我是斯坦福监狱实验的负责人。

sentences.en: And these were men and women who were putting prisoners through unbelievable humiliation.
sentences.zh: 当时我是斯坦福监狱实验的负责人。布什政府军方对此事的第一反应是什么？是丑闻发生后任何官方都会说的套词，

sentences.en: I was shocked, but I wasn't surprised, because I had seen those same visual parallels when I was the prison superintendent of the Stanford Prison Study.
sentences.zh: "不要怪我们。这与整个系统无关。只是几个坏苹果而已，只是一小撮恶劣的士兵而已。"而我的假设是，美国士兵通常情况下是好的。

sentences.en: Immediately the Bush administration military said what?
sentences.zh: 而我的假设是，美国士兵通常情况下是好的。也许是装苹果的桶坏了。但我如何证明这个假设呢？

sentences.en: What all administrations say when there's a scandal: "Don't blame us. It's not the system.
sentences.zh: 但我如何证明这个假设呢？我成为了其中一个名叫奇普·弗莱德里克中士的专家证人，

sentences.en: It's the few bad apples, the few rogue soldiers."
sentences.zh: 奇普·弗莱德里克中士的专家证人，在这个位置上，我可以接触到关于此事的十几份调查报告。

sentences.en: My hypothesis is, American soldiers are good, usually.
sentences.zh: 在这个位置上，我可以接触到关于此事的十几份调查报告。我同他接触，我可以研究他，

sentences.en: Maybe it was the barrel that was bad. But how am I going to deal with that hypothesis?
sentences.zh: 我同他接触，我可以研究他，让他来我家，了解他，作些心理上的分析来判断他是个好苹果还是坏苹果。

sentences.en: I became an expert witness for one of the guards, Sergeant Chip Frederick, and in that position, I had access to the dozen investigative reports.
sentences.zh: 作些心理上的分析来判断他是个好苹果还是坏苹果。第三点，我可以查看所有的

sentences.en: I had access to him. I could study him, have him come to my home, get to know him, do psychological analysis to see, was he a good apple or bad apple.
sentences.zh: 第三点，我可以查看所有的1000多张士兵拍摄的照片。这些照片都是暴力或色情的。所有这些都是美军士兵用相机拍摄的。因为每个人都有数码相机或手机相机，

sentences.en: And thirdly, I had access to all of the 1,000 pictures that these soldiers took.
sentences.zh: 因为每个人都有数码相机或手机相机，他们什么都拍。拍了超过1000张照片。我所做的是把它们分类。

sentences.en: These pictures are of a violent or sexual nature.
sentences.zh: 我所做的是把它们分类。但这些由陆军预备役的美军宪兵所拍摄的。

sentences.en: All of them come from the cameras of American soldiers.
sentences.zh: 但这些由陆军预备役的美军宪兵所拍摄的。

sentences.en: Because everybody has a digital camera or cell phone camera, they took pictures of everything, more than 1,000.
sentences.zh: 但这些由陆军预备役的美军宪兵所拍摄的。他们完全不是为执行此项任务而设立的部队。而此事仅发生在一个地点，1A层，在夜间值班时间。

sentences.en: And what I've done is I organized them into various categories.
sentences.zh: 而此事仅发生在一个地点，1A层，在夜间值班时间。

sentences.en: But these are by United States military police, army reservists.
sentences.zh: 而此事仅发生在一个地点，1A层，在夜间值班时间。为什么？1A层是军方情报中心。是审讯关押处。中央情报局在那里。

sentences.en: They are not soldiers prepared for this mission at all.
sentences.zh: 是审讯关押处。中央情报局在那里。巨人公司（美军外包公司）的审讯人员，全部都在那里，

sentences.en: And it all happened in a single place, Tier 1-A, on the night shift.
sentences.zh: 巨人公司（美军外包公司）的审讯人员，全部都在那里，而他们得不到任何关于暴动的信息。

sentences.en: Why? Tier 1-A was the center for military intelligence.
sentences.zh: 而他们得不到任何关于暴动的信息。于是他们向这些宪兵队士兵施加压力，迫使他们越线，

sentences.en: It was the interrogation hold. The CIA was there.
sentences.zh: 迫使他们越线，允许他们采取措施来击溃敌人的意志，

sentences.en: Interrogators from Titan Corporation, all there, and they're getting no information about the insurgency.
sentences.zh: 允许他们采取措施来击溃敌人的意志，挽起袖子，为审讯做准备，使他们屈服。这些都是婉辞，而这就是他们如何阐释的。

sentences.en: So they're going to put pressure on these soldiers, military police, to cross the line, give them permission to break the will of the enemy, to prepare them for interrogation, to soften them up, to take the gloves off.
sentences.zh: 而这就是他们如何阐释的。让我们进入那个地牢吧。（相机快门声）（以下图片含有裸露及暴力展示）

sentences.en: Those are the euphemisms, and this is how it was interpreted.
sentences.zh: （相机快门声）（以下图片含有裸露及暴力展示）

sentences.en: Let's go down to that dungeon. (Typewriting) [Abu Ghraib Iraq Prison Abuses 2008 Military Police Guards' Photos] [The following images include nudity and graphic depictions of violence]
sentences.zh: （相机快门声）（以下图片含有裸露及暴力展示）

sentences.en: (Camera shutter sounds) (Thuds)
sentences.zh: （相机快门声）（以下图片含有裸露及暴力展示）（重击声）（相机快门声）

sentences.en: (Camera shutter) (Camera shutter)
sentences.zh: （相机快门声）（重击声）（喘息声）

sentences.en: (Breathing) (Bells) (Bells end)
sentences.zh: （钟声）很恐怖。这是恶的一种视觉展示。你应该不会没有注意到，我把那个伸开双臂的囚犯和达芬奇颂扬人类的作品放在一起的原因，

sentences.en: So, pretty horrific. That's one of the visual illustrations of evil.
sentences.zh: 和达芬奇颂扬人类的作品放在一起的原因，是那个犯人得了精神疾病。那个犯人每天用大便涂抹在身上，士兵们不得不使他在泥土里打滚，以消除臭味。

sentences.en: And it should not have escaped you that the reason I paired the prisoner with his arms out with Leonardo da Vinci's ode to humanity is that prisoner was mentally ill.
sentences.zh: 士兵们不得不使他在泥土里打滚，以消除臭味。但士兵们最终还是叫他屎男。他在监狱里做什么？!他本应在精神病院。不管怎样，前国防部长拉姆斯菲尔德

sentences.en: That prisoner covered himself with shit every day, they had to roll him in dirt so he wouldn't stink.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，前国防部长拉姆斯菲尔德下来问，"我想知道谁该为此负责？到底谁才是那几个坏苹果？"嗯，这是个差劲的问题。

sentences.en: But the guards ended up calling him "Shit Boy."
sentences.zh: 到底谁才是那几个坏苹果？"嗯，这是个差劲的问题。

sentences.en: What was he doing in that prison rather than in some mental institution?
sentences.zh: 到底谁才是那几个坏苹果？"嗯，这是个差劲的问题。你应该重新组织一下这个句子，"是什么为此负责？"因为"什么"既可以是指人，

sentences.en: In any event, here's former Secretary of Defense Rumsfeld.
sentences.zh: 因为"什么"既可以是指人，也可以是指情境，而显然那样问是坚持错误。

sentences.en: He comes down and says, "I want to know, who is responsible?
sentences.zh: 而显然那样问是坚持错误。那么心理学家是如何理解

sentences.en: Who are the bad apples?" Well, that's a bad question.
sentences.zh: 那么心理学家是如何理解这种人性的转变呢？如果你相信他们在进入地牢之前

sentences.en: You have to reframe it and ask, "What is responsible?"
sentences.zh: 如果你相信他们在进入地牢之前是好士兵的话。

sentences.en: "What" could be the who of people, but it could also be the what of the situation, and obviously that's wrongheaded.
sentences.zh: 是好士兵的话。有三种方式。最主要的方式是所谓的特质论。我们查看那些坏苹果的内在特征。

sentences.en: How do psychologists try to understand such transformations of human character, if you believe that they were good soldiers before they went down to that dungeon?
sentences.zh: 我们查看那些坏苹果的内在特征。这是所有社会科学的基础，宗教的基础，战争的基础。

sentences.en: There are three ways. The main way is called dispositional.
sentences.zh: 宗教的基础，战争的基础。像我这样的社会心理学家会出来说，"是啊，人们是舞台上的演员，

sentences.en: We look at what's inside of the person, the bad apples.
sentences.zh: 人们是舞台上的演员，但你得清楚其所处的情境。

sentences.en: This is the foundation of all of social science, the foundation of religion, the foundation of war.
sentences.zh: 但你得清楚其所处的情境。扮演角色的演员是哪些人？戏服什么样？有舞台导演吗？所以我们感兴趣的是，个体周围的外界因素

sentences.en: Social psychologists like me come along and say, "Yeah, people are the actors on the stage, but you'll have to be aware of the situation.
sentences.zh: 所以我们感兴趣的是，个体周围的外界因素是什么，坏的苹果桶？社会学家研究的仅限于此，却遗漏了这个很重要的问题，即我在成为阿布格莱布虐囚事件的专家证人后所发现的：

sentences.en: Who are the cast of characters? What's the costume?
sentences.zh: 即我在成为阿布格莱布虐囚事件的专家证人后所发现的：权力存在于系统中。

sentences.en: Is there a stage director?" And so we're interested in what are the external factors around the individual -- the bad barrel?
sentences.zh: 权力存在于系统中。系统制造出腐化个体的情境，这个系统，是指法制、政治、经济和文化背景。

sentences.en: Social scientists stop there and they miss the big point that I discovered when I became an expert witness for Abu Ghraib.
sentences.zh: 这个系统，是指法制、政治、经济和文化背景。该系统即苹果桶制造者权力之所在。

sentences.en: The power is in the system. The system creates the situation that corrupts the individuals, and the system is the legal, political, economic, cultural background.
sentences.zh: 如果你想改变一个人，你就得改变其所处的情境。如果你要改变情境，你得知道其权力存在于系统的何处。所以路西法效应牵涉到理解人性转变是如何受这三项因素影响的。

sentences.en: And this is where the power is of the bad-barrel makers.
sentences.zh: 人性转变是如何受这三项因素影响的。

sentences.en: If you want to change a person, change the situation.
sentences.zh: 人性转变是如何受这三项因素影响的。它是一个相互作用的过程。人们会怎样影响情境？

sentences.en: And to change it, you've got to know where the power is, in the system.
sentences.zh: 人们会怎样影响情境？情境如何影响人们？制造并维持该情境的系统是什么？

sentences.en: So the Lucifer effect involves understanding human character transformations with these three factors.
sentences.zh: 制造并维持该情境的系统是什么？我最近出版的书《路西法效应》，就是关于我们如何理解好人是怎样变成恶人的。

sentences.en: And it's a dynamic interplay. What do the people bring into the situation?
sentences.zh: 就是关于我们如何理解好人是怎样变成恶人的。书中有关于我今天演讲内容的大量细节。

sentences.en: What does the situation bring out of them?
sentences.zh: 的大量细节。

sentences.en: And what is the system that creates and maintains that situation?
sentences.zh: 的大量细节。所以，津博士的《路西法效应》，尽管着重于恶，但其实是颂扬人类有无限的潜力，

sentences.en: My recent book, "The Lucifer Effect," is about, how do you understand how good people turn evil?
sentences.zh: 但其实是颂扬人类有无限的潜力，使我们任何人向善或作恶，

sentences.en: And it has a lot of detail about what I'm going to talk about today.
sentences.zh: 使我们任何人向善或作恶，关怀或冷漠，创造或毁灭，

sentences.en: So Dr. Z's "Lucifer Effect," although it focuses on evil, really is a celebration of the human mind's infinite capacity to make any of us kind or cruel, caring or indifferent, creative or destructive,
sentences.zh: 甚至可以使得我们其中一些人成为恶棍。而我在最后将满怀希望地给大家讲一个好消息的故事，即这潜力也可以使我们其中一些人成为英雄。这是登在《纽约客》上非常棒的一个漫画，它其实总结了我的全部演讲："杰罗姆，我既不是好警察也不是坏警察，

sentences.en: and it makes some of us villains. And the good news that I'm going to hopefully come to at the end is that it makes some of us heroes.
sentences.zh: "杰罗姆，我既不是好警察也不是坏警察，跟你一样，我是一个正面和负面人格特质的复杂混合体，至于体现哪一面，要靠具体情况而言。"

sentences.en: This wonderful cartoon in the New Yorker summarizes my whole talk: "I'm neither a good cop nor a bad cop, Jerome.

sentences.zh: 调节的意思是，你几乎可以从使绝大多数人完全服从，

sentences.zh: 理解不是找借口。心理学不是借口学。

sentences.en: Your personality and morality are disengaged.
sentences.zh: 理解不是找借口。心理学不是借口学。社会学和心理学研究揭示了在无需药物的情况下，普通的好人是如何被转变的。

sentences.en: "Nothing is easier than to denounce the evildoer; nothing more difficult than understanding him," Dostoyevsky.
sentences.zh: 在无需药物的情况下，普通的好人是如何被转变的。你不需要药物，你只需要社会心理学的过程。真实世界的情况？和这个比较一下。

sentences.en: Understanding is not excusing. Psychology is not excuse-ology.
sentences.zh: 真实世界的情况？和这个比较一下。

sentences.en: So social and psychological research reveals how ordinary, good people can be transformed without the drugs.
sentences.zh: 真实世界的情况？和这个比较一下。我以詹姆斯·施莱辛格的话作为结束，"心理学家已尝试理解,

sentences.en: You don't need it. You just need the social-psychological processes.
sentences.zh: "心理学家已尝试理解,一般情况下具备人性的个体和群体，为什么以及如何

sentences.en: Real world parallels? Compare this with this.
sentences.zh: 一般情况下具备人性的个体和群体，为什么以及如何会在某些情境下，作出反常行为。"

sentences.en: James Schlesinger -- I'm going to end with this -- says, "Psychologists have attempted to understand how and why individuals and groups who usually act humanely can sometimes act otherwise in certain circumstances."
sentences.zh: 他接着说，"具有标志性的斯坦福实验给了所有军事行为一个警告。"如果你在没有监督的情况下赋予人们权力，那就是在给滥用开通行证。他们明明了解后果，却任其发生。

sentences.en: That's the Lucifer effect. And he goes on to say, "The landmark Stanford study provides a cautionary tale for all military operations."
sentences.zh: 那就是在给滥用开通行证。他们明明了解后果，却任其发生。另一个报告，是费将军所做的调查，认为整个系统是有罪的，在该报告中，

sentences.en: If you give people power without oversight, it's a prescription for abuse.
sentences.zh: 认为整个系统是有罪的，在该报告中，他认为是环境造成了阿布格莱布事件，领导力的失误，

sentences.en: They knew that, and let that happen. So another report, an investigative report by General Fay, says the system is guilty.
sentences.zh: 领导力的失误，导致了虐待的发生，以及在很长一段时间内，当局高层一直被蒙在鼓里。那些虐待行为持续了三个月。有谁在看管吗？

sentences.en: In this report, he says it was the environment that created Abu Ghraib, by leadership failures that contributed to the occurrence of such abuse, and because it remained undiscovered by higher authorities for a long period of time.
sentences.zh: 那些虐待行为持续了三个月。有谁在看管吗？答案是没有人，我认为，是没有人主动去。他允许警卫们作那些恶行，他们知道没有人会下地牢来查看。所以我们在所有这些方面进行模式上的转变。

sentences.en: Those abuses went on for three months. Who was watching the store?
sentences.zh: 所以我们在所有这些方面进行模式上的转变。原来的医疗模式，只集中于个体，

sentences.en: The answer is nobody, I think on purpose.
sentences.zh: 只集中于个体，必须转向一个公共健康模式，

sentences.en: He gave the guards permission to do those things, and they knew nobody was ever going to come down to that dungeon.
sentences.zh: 必须转向一个公共健康模式，这个模式同时考虑情境和系统对疾病的作用。欺侮是病。偏见是病。暴力是病。

sentences.en: So you need a paradigm shift in all of these areas.
sentences.zh: 欺侮是病。偏见是病。暴力是病。

sentences.en: The shift is away from the medical model that focuses only on the individual.
sentences.zh: 欺侮是病。偏见是病。暴力是病。自从审讯以来，我们一直在个人层面解决问题。你猜怎么着，没用。

sentences.en: The shift is toward a public health model that recognizes situational and systemic vectors of disease.
sentences.zh: 解决问题。你猜怎么着，没用。亚历山大·索尔仁尼琴认为每个人心中都有善恶的分界线。

sentences.en: Bullying is a disease. Prejudice is a disease.
sentences.zh: 都有善恶的分界线。也就是说，这条线不是外在的。

sentences.en: Violence is a disease. Since the Inquisition, we've been dealing with problems at the individual level.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，这条线不是外在的。这是一个你必须作出的决定。是个人层面的。那么，我想以一个正面的意见来做个简短的结尾：

sentences.en: It doesn't work. Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn says, "The line between good and evil cuts through the heart of every human being."
sentences.zh: 那么，我想以一个正面的意见来做个简短的结尾：英雄主义是恶的解药。通过推广英雄主义想象，尤其是在我们的孩子之中，在教育系统里。

sentences.en: That means that line is not out there. That's a decision that you have to make, a personal thing.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在我们的孩子之中，在教育系统里。我们要孩子们想，我是那个等待中的英雄，等待合适的情境出现，

sentences.en: So I want to end very quickly on a positive note.
sentences.zh: 等待合适的情境出现，届时我会行英雄之事。

sentences.en: Heroism as the antidote to evil, by promoting the heroic imagination, especially in our kids, in our educational system.
sentences.zh: 届时我会行英雄之事。我一生自小与恶相伴，如今我毕生努力之重点，将从研究恶转向理解英雄主义。现在所谓的英雄主义是，

sentences.en: We want kids to think, "I'm a hero in waiting, waiting for the right situation to come along, and I will act heroically.
sentences.zh: 现在所谓的英雄主义是，平凡之人行英雄之事。这是对汉娜·阿伦特的平庸之恶的反驳。我们传统的社会英雄是错误的，

sentences.en: My whole life, I'm now going to focus away from evil -- that I've been in since I was a kid -- to understanding heroes.
sentences.zh: 我们传统的社会英雄是错误的，因为他们是极少数例外。他们为目标投入毕生之努力。因此我们才知道他们的名字。

sentences.en: Banality of heroism. It's ordinary people who do heroic deeds.
sentences.zh: 因此我们才知道他们的名字。孩子们的英雄也是他们的榜样，因为他们有超自然能力。

sentences.en: It's the counterpoint to Hannah Arendt's "Banality of Evil."
sentences.zh: 因为他们有超自然能力。我们想要让孩子们意识到，大多数英雄是平凡的人们，

sentences.en: Our traditional societal heroes are wrong, because they are the exceptions.
sentences.zh: 我们想要让孩子们意识到，大多数英雄是平凡的人们，而英雄行为是不平凡的。这是乔·达比。

sentences.en: They organize their life around this. That's why we know their names.
sentences.zh: 而英雄行为是不平凡的。这是乔·达比。就是他阻止了你们前面所见的那些虐行，

sentences.en: Our kids' heroes are also wrong models for them, because they have supernatural talents.
sentences.zh: 因为当他看到那些图片时，他把它们交给了一位高级调查官。

sentences.en: We want our kids to realize most heroes are everyday people, and the heroic act is unusual.
sentences.zh: 他把它们交给了一位高级调查官。他是一个低级列兵但却阻止了此事。他是英雄吗？不是。他们不得不把他藏起来，因为有人想杀他，

sentences.en: This is Joe Darby. He was the one that stopped those abuses you saw, because when he saw those images, he turned them over to a senior investigating officer.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不把他藏起来，因为有人想杀他，还有他的母亲和妻子。他们隐藏了三年。这个女人阻止了斯坦福监狱实验。

sentences.en: He was a low-level private, and that stopped it.
sentences.zh: 这个女人阻止了斯坦福监狱实验。当我说实验失控的时候，我当时是监狱实验负责人。

sentences.en: Was he a hero? No. They had to put him in hiding, because people wanted to kill him, and then his mother and his wife.
sentences.zh: 当我说实验失控的时候，我当时是监狱实验负责人。我不知道实验已经失控了。我完全无动于衷。她下来看到这疯人院一样的监狱说，"你知道吗？你对这些男孩所做的一切实在是太可怕了。

sentences.en: For three years, they were in hiding. This is the woman who stopped the Stanford Prison Study.
sentences.zh: "你知道吗？你对这些男孩所做的一切实在是太可怕了。他们不是囚犯，不是警卫，他们只是孩子，你要为他们负责。"

sentences.en: When I said it got out of control, I was the prison superintendent.
sentences.zh: 他们只是孩子，你要为他们负责。"我第二天就停止了这个实验。

sentences.en: I didn't know it was out of control. I was totally indifferent.
sentences.zh: 我第二天就停止了这个实验。好消息是，我第二年就娶了她。

sentences.en: She saw that madhouse and said, "You know what, it's terrible what you're doing to those boys.
sentences.zh: 好消息是，我第二年就娶了她。（笑声）（鼓掌）

sentences.en: They're not prisoners nor guards, they're boys, and you are responsible."
sentences.zh: （鼓掌）

sentences.en: And I ended the study the next day. The good news is I married her the next year.
sentences.zh: （鼓掌）显然，我醒悟了。所以情境是有力量的——

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) I just came to my senses, obviously.
sentences.zh: 所以情境是有力量的——关键是，这个情境可以刺激一些人内心的敌意想象，使我们成为恶之犯人，也可以激发另外一些人内心的英雄想象。情境是同样的情境。

sentences.en: So situations have the power to do [three things].
sentences.zh: 也可以激发另外一些人内心的英雄想象。情境是同样的情境。而你二者必居其一。

sentences.en: But the point is, this is the same situation that can inflame the hostile imagination in some of us, that makes us perpetrators of evil, can inspire the heroic imagination in others.
sentences.zh: 而你二者必居其一。大多数人对袖手旁观之恶感到内疚，因为你母亲会说，"别管闲事，先管好你自己的事。"你一定得这么回答，"妈妈，人性就是我的事。"英雄主义的心理学是——我们很快会结束——

sentences.en: It's the same situation and you're on one side or the other.
sentences.zh: 英雄主义的心理学是——我们很快会结束——我们如何在新的英雄课程里鼓励孩子们，

sentences.en: Most people are guilty of the evil of inaction, because your mother said, "Don't get involved. Mind your own business."
sentences.zh: 我们如何在新的英雄课程里鼓励孩子们，我正与马特·郎登从事这项工作——他有一个英雄工作坊——来培养这种英雄想象，这种自我标签，

sentences.en: And you have to say, "Mama, humanity is my business."
sentences.zh: 来培养这种英雄想象，这种自我标签，"我是一个等待中的英雄"，并且教会他们技能。

sentences.en: So the psychology of heroism is -- we're going to end in a moment -- how do we encourage children in new hero courses, that I'm working on with Matt Langdon -- he has a hero workshop -- to develop this heroic imagination, this self-labeling,
sentences.zh: "我是一个等待中的英雄"，并且教会他们技能。想成为英雄的话，你一定要学会成为一个"异类"，因为你得总是与群体规范相左。英雄是那些在社会上行非凡之事的平凡人。那些有所为之人。英雄主义之关键有二。

sentences.en: "I am a hero in waiting," and teach them skills.
sentences.zh: 英雄主义之关键有二。一：在众人消极冷漠之时有所作为。

sentences.en: To be a hero, you have to learn to be a deviant, because you're always going against the conformity of the group.
sentences.zh: 一：在众人消极冷漠之时有所作为。二：你的作为必须以社会为中心，而非以自我为中心。我想以韦斯利·奥特里，纽约地铁英雄的故事来结尾，

sentences.en: Heroes are ordinary people whose social actions are extraordinary. Who act.
sentences.zh: 我想以韦斯利·奥特里，纽约地铁英雄的故事来结尾，你们其中一些人知道这个故事。他是一个50岁的非裔美国人，是一个建筑工人。

sentences.en: The key to heroism is two things. You have to act when other people are passive.
sentences.zh: 他是一个50岁的非裔美国人，是一个建筑工人。他在纽约地铁等车的时候，一个白人掉进地铁轨道里。当时地铁正开过来。当时有75个人在那儿。

sentences.en: B: You have to act socio-centrically, not egocentrically.
sentences.zh: 当时地铁正开过来。当时有75个人在那儿。你猜怎么着，他们全都僵住了。

sentences.en: And I want to end with a known story about Wesley Autrey, New York subway hero.
sentences.zh: 你猜怎么着，他们全都僵住了。他有理由袖手旁观。他是黑人，那个人是白人，他还有两个小孩。

sentences.en: Fifty-year-old African-American construction worker standing on a subway.
sentences.zh: 他是黑人，那个人是白人，他还有两个小孩。相反的是，他把两个孩子交给一个陌生人看管，跳进铁轨里，把那男子压在铁轨之间，

sentences.en: A white guy falls on the tracks. The subway train is coming. There's 75 people there.
sentences.zh: 跳进铁轨里，把那男子压在铁轨之间，趴在他身上，地铁就从他身上开了过去。韦斯利和那个男子摞起来高20.5英寸。

sentences.en: You know what? They freeze. He's got a reason not to get involved.
sentences.zh: 韦斯利和那个男子摞起来高20.5英寸。

sentences.en: He's black, the guy's white, and he's got two kids.
sentences.zh: 韦斯利和那个男子摞起来高20.5英寸。地铁列车下的空隙高21英寸。再低半英寸就会把他的脑袋铲去。

sentences.en: Instead, he gives his kids to a stranger, jumps on the tracks, puts the guy between the tracks, lays on him, the subway goes over him.
sentences.zh: 再低半英寸就会把他的脑袋铲去。而他却说"我做了任何人都会做的事"，跳下铁轨没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: Wesley and the guy -- 20 and a half inches height.
sentences.zh: 跳下铁轨没什么大不了的。从道德责任的角度说应该是"我做了任何人应该做的事"。

sentences.en: The train clearance is 21 inches. A half an inch would have taken his head off.
sentences.zh: 从道德责任的角度说应该是"我做了任何人应该做的事"。那么，将来有一天，你会遇到一个新的情境。第一条路，你会成为恶之犯人。

sentences.en: And he said, "I did what anyone could do," no big deal to jump on the tracks.
sentences.zh: 第一条路，你会成为恶之犯人。恶，即你将成为亚瑟·安德森。你将会欺骗，或允许欺侮。

sentences.en: And the moral imperative is "I did what everyone should do."
sentences.zh: 你将会欺骗，或允许欺侮。第二条路：你将因漠不关心袖手旁观而内疚。

sentences.en: And so one day, you will be in a new situation.
sentences.zh: 第二条路：你将因漠不关心袖手旁观而内疚。第三条路：你成为一个英雄。关键是，我们是否做好准备来选择这条路

sentences.en: Take path one, you're going to be a perpetrator of evil.
sentences.zh: 关键是，我们是否做好准备来选择这条路以颂扬平凡的英雄，

sentences.en: Evil, meaning you're going to be Arthur Andersen.
sentences.zh: 以颂扬平凡的英雄，等待合适的情境出现，

sentences.en: You're going to cheat, or you're going to allow bullying.
sentences.zh: 等待合适的情境出现，将对于英雄的想象付诸于实施呢？

sentences.en: Path two, you become guilty of the evil of passive inaction.
sentences.zh: 将对于英雄的想象付诸于实施呢？因为这可能是你平生仅有的机会，

sentences.en: Path three, you become a hero. The point is, are we ready to take the path to celebrating ordinary heroes, waiting for the right situation to come along to put heroic imagination into action?
sentences.zh: 因为这可能是你平生仅有的机会，而当你错过的时候，你将永远记得，我本可以成为一个英雄但我让这机会溜走了。所以关键是先想再做。所以我想谢谢你们。谢谢你们。谢谢。让我们反对国内外的恶之系统的力量，

sentences.en: Because it may only happen once in your life, and when you pass it by, you'll always know, I could have been a hero and I let it pass me by.
sentences.zh: 让我们反对国内外的恶之系统的力量，并集中于积极的一面。倡导对个人高尚行为之尊敬，倡导正义与和平，

sentences.en: So the point is thinking it and then doing it.
sentences.zh: 倡导对个人高尚行为之尊敬，倡导正义与和平，遗憾的是，我们的当局并没有在做这些。

sentences.en: So I want to thank you. Thank you. Let's oppose the power of evil systems at home and abroad, and let's focus on the positive.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。（掌声）

sentences.en: Advocate for respect of personal dignity, for justice and peace, which sadly our administration has not been doing.
sentences.zh: （掌声）

sentences.en: Thanks so much. (Applause)
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。 （掌声）
